info.name: KHR_LIGHT_RING
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension, trimmed to what this device implements. Omitted registry parameters: 'falloffAngle' (Cycles area-light spread has a fixed built-in soft edge; setting it warns and is ignored), 'innerRadius' (no Cycles analog for an annulus; nonzero values warn and the light stays a full disc), and 'intensityDistribution'/'c0' (photometric distributions are not implemented; see task 17). Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: the axis the ring is pointing at

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: overall amount of light emitted in a direction in W/sr

parameters.name: power
parameters.description: overall amount of light energy emitted in W

parameters.name: radiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the light source in a direction in W/sr/m^2
